rules: Student's rules, v2 of 2026-11-16. Runs = video minutes per item ticked (PDF, Text, Quiz: 1 run each, open and mark complete only). Over = one day ending 03:00 IST. Par = RRR at the over's start. Wicket (max one per over): 0-run over, 3 holds in a day, broken return, 3 overs below par (red 1, orange 0.5). Wicket back: boss beaten, 5 green overs in a row. 2 rain days, declared the day before. All out = match lost, follow-on, next par x1.5. Full text: top of tools/score.py and skill section 11.
